title: This Pilot Fought 30 Enemy Planes Alone

scenes.headline: 1 VS 30
scenes.text: This pilot fought thirty enemy planes. Alone.

scenes.headline: 1 VS 30
scenes.text: The bomber crews watching him could not believe it.

scenes.headline: JAN 11, 1944
scenes.text: January eleventh, nineteen forty-four. American bombers are deep over Germany.

scenes.headline: ON HIS OWN
scenes.text: Major James Howard flies a P-51 Mustang. In the chaos, he loses his group.

scenes.headline: 30+ FIGHTERS
scenes.text: Then he sees it. More than thirty German fighters attacking the bombers.

scenes.headline: NO HELP
scenes.text: No other escorts are close. He could turn back.

scenes.headline: HE ATTACKS
scenes.text: Instead, he dives straight into them.

scenes.headline: 30 MINUTES
scenes.text: For about thirty minutes, he attacks again and again.

scenes.headline: GUNS DOWN
scenes.text: Then three of his four guns stop firing. He keeps attacking with just one.

scenes.headline: MEDAL OF HONOR
scenes.text: He was credited with at least three kills, and received the Medal of Honor.

scenes.headline: WOULD YOU?
scenes.text: One pilot. One gun. Thirty enemies. Would you have turned back?
